迁移、备份恢复和日常维护。: Migration, backup, recovery and routine maintenance.

例如 daily-backup，小写字母、数字和连字符: E.g. daily-backup; lowercase letters, digits and hyphens
同一计划不会并发运行。备份及快照不会自动清理，请定期检查容量和备份链。: Runs of the same schedule do not overlap. Backups and snapshots are not automatically removed; check capacity and backup chains regularly.
停写并检查挂载、快照及可用容量。: Stop writes and check mounts, snapshots and available capacity.
复制到新镜像，或依次执行迁移准备和数据复制。: Copy to a new image, or perform migration preparation followed by data copying.
校验数据与应用，再提交迁移或切换业务。: Verify data and applications, then commit the migration or switch traffic.

创建全量备份，再基于备份编号创建增量。: Create a full backup, then incremental backups based on its ID.
定期校验，并恢复到新镜像进行演练。: Verify regularly and rehearse restores to a new image.
快照保留在源集群，无法替代异地备份。数据库备份前请由应用完成停写或一致性快照。: Snapshots remain in the source cluster and do not replace off-site backups. Applications must stop database writes or take consistent snapshots before backup.
CSI 管理的卷请使用 PVC 扩容、迁移和换卷流程。直接修改底层镜像不会更新: For CSI-managed volumes, use PVC expansion, migration and replacement workflows. Direct changes to underlying images do not update PVC metadata.
任务每 10 秒刷新。长任务由集群持续执行；取消不会撤销已完成的修改。巡检、修复: Tasks refresh every 10 seconds. Long tasks continue in the cluster; cancellation does not undo completed changes. Observe Ceph status after inspection or repair commands succeed.
目录读取持久化 PVC 中的备份清单，任务记录清理后仍可恢复。文件存在不代表校验: The catalog reads backup manifests from persistent PVC storage and remains available after task records are removed. File presence does not prove integrity; verify backups and rehearse restores regularly.
暂无备份，请选择已就绪的仓库并创建全量备份: No backups. Select a ready repository and create a full backup.

调整副本数会触发数据重新均衡（rebalance）。在 3 节点集群中，建议副本: Changing replica count triggers data rebalancing. Three replicas are recommended for a three-node cluster; too few replicas reduce reliability.
PG 数建议按 (OSD数量 × 100) / 副本数 估算，如 3 OSD 三: Estimate PG count as (OSDs × 100) / replicas; three OSDs with three replicas gives about 100 PGs. Adjust PG count after creation if needed.
增加 PG 数会触发 PG 分裂与数据重均衡；减小 PG 数可能触发合并。建议在: Increasing PGs triggers splitting and rebalancing; decreasing may trigger merging. Perform this during a maintenance window.
未勾选时保持当前配额；勾选并填 0 解除容量限制: Unchecked preserves the current quota; check and enter 0 to remove the capacity limit
未勾选时保持当前配额；勾选并填 0 解除对象数限制: Unchecked preserves the current quota; check and enter 0 to remove the object limit
压缩仅对新写入的数据生效，可显著节省空间（适合日志/文本类数据），会消耗少量 C: Compression applies only to newly written data. It saves space, especially for logs/text, with some CPU overhead.
RBD 为块设备（thin provisioning 按需分配）。创建的镜像可通: RBD provides thin-provisioned block devices. Images can be used as PVCs through the Kubernetes ceph-rbd StorageClass.
扩容安全；缩容需勾选\"允许缩容\"且目标容量须大于已使用量，否则数据会损坏。: Expansion is safe. Shrinking requires Allow shrinking and a target capacity larger than actual usage; otherwise data may be damaged.
快照是镜像某一时刻的只读副本，可用于备份与恢复。克隆镜像前需将快照设为\"已保护: Snapshots are read-only point-in-time image copies for backup and recovery. Protect a snapshot before cloning it.
克隆为写时复制（COW）子镜像，初始不占额外空间。源快照必须\"已保护\"（需先: Clones are copy-on-write child images with no initial extra space usage. The source snapshot must be protected first using rbd snap protect.
权重为 0 表示该 OSD 不接收新数据（配合 out 使用）；调低权重可减少其: A weight of 0 prevents new data placement on the OSD (use with out). Lower weights reduce data placement for maintenance or migration.
新容量必须大于当前容量，例如：10Gi → 20Gi: New capacity must exceed current capacity, e.g. 10Gi → 20Gi
默认与源 PVC 相同: Defaults to the source PVC namespace

此功能用于创建静态 PV（HostPath / NFS / Local / CS: Create static HostPath / NFS / Local / CSI PVs here. For dynamic CSI storage such as TopoLVM, use Create PVC to provision a PV automatically; do not create it manually.
Local - 本地静态盘（需 no-provisioner 存储类）: Local - Static local disk (requires no-provisioner StorageClass)
Local 静态 PV 需配合 kubernetes.io/no-provisi: Static Local PVs require a kubernetes.io/no-provisioner StorageClass and an existing path on the node. For TopoLVM, use Create PVC for dynamic provisioning.
该存储类由 CSI 控制器自动创建 PV，手动创建静态 PV 不会被正常绑定。T: The CSI controller creates PVs automatically for this StorageClass; manually created static PVs will not bind normally. For dynamic storage such as TopoLVM, close this dialog and use Create PVC.
每行一个 key=value，例如：\nclusterID=rook-ceph\: One key=value per line, e.g. clusterID=rook-ceph, pool=replicapool and imageFormat=2 on separate lines
目标 PVC 不存在时自动创建: Create the target PVC if it does not exist

可选，用于精确定位要替换的卷: Optional; identifies the exact volume to replace
换卷后工作负载将滚动重启以挂载新卷，请确认数据已迁移完成且新 PVC 已存在。: Replacing the volume triggers a rolling workload restart to mount it. Confirm migration is complete and the new PVC exists.
